name: cockpit
title: Svala GT cockpit
description: An instrument cluster over a touchscreen for a made-up car, running in the page: a 3D car whose doors open, climate, media, a map.
summary: An instrument cluster over a touchscreen, for a car that does not exist. Open its doors on the 3D car, set the climate, play music, follow the route. The pages are the Ljós dialect over typed TypeScript; the drive runs on timers, and nothing runs while nothing changes.
tryThis: Change any of them: the cockpit is made again from your files as soon as they compile. Try Theme.qml's cyan, or the first leg of the drive in logic/drive.ts.
cardBody: Svala GT, a car that does not exist: an instrument cluster over a touchscreen, with the car in 3D, climate, media and a map. On a page of its own, with every file to change.
cardAlt: A car's instrument cluster over a touchscreen showing the car in 3D.
shows: A car's instrument cluster, speed and power dials either side of the gear, over a touchscreen showing the car in 3D, music, climate or a map.

name: watch
title: Kestrel, a smartwatch
description: The software of a made-up smartwatch, running in the page at its round and rounded-square screens, and the watch in 3D with its lights blooming.
summary: The software of a watch that does not exist, for a round screen and a rounded square. Swipe between its screens, turn the crown with the wheel, let it rest on its always-on face. The screens are the Ljós dialect over typed TypeScript; asleep, only the clock wakes, once a minute.
use: Wear it with the pointer. From the face, swipe up for notifications, down for quick settings and left for the apps; swipe right to go back, and hold the face to change it. The wheel turns the crown; the keys under the watch are its side button and crown, its other screen, and rest. Left alone for fifteen seconds it rests on its always-on face. The 3D watch's case, glass and band are glTF files, which only the WebGPU renderer reads; a browser without WebGPU draws its light strips alone.
tryThis: Change any of them: the watch is made again from your files as soon as they compile. Try Theme.qml's cyan, or the names of the faces in Watch.qml.
cardBody: Kestrel, a watch that does not exist: two faces, a round screen and a rounded square, the crown on the mouse wheel, an always-on face, and the watch in 3D. On a page of its own, with every file to change.
cardAlt: A round smartwatch face with neon rings beside the same watch in 3D.
shows: A round smartwatch face with neon rings beside the same watch in 3D, its light strips glowing.
